newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Coffee-Indonesia prices weak despite tight supply.
newsitem.headline: Coffee-Indonesia prices weak despite tight supply.

text.p: Indonesian coffee prices weakened further despite relatively tight supply in the local market, traders said.
One trader in Jakarta said coffee prices in the main growing areas of Lampung and Palembang were quoted around 2,950 rupiah/kg, compared with the high of 3,400 rupiah in August.
He attributed the decline to weakening offshore markets and the possible emerging of Vietnam coffee in the short-term.
"People are waiting for Vietnam coffee to come up. So buyers seem to be holding back from buying," he said.
However, the downside for domestic prices appeared to be limited because of the current tight supply.
Traders said the export price of grade four Robusta also eased to $1,280/tonne against $1,400/tonne last month.
They said large export commitments seemed to have dried up domestic supply.
